short_description: Apply Tailwind Design System with explicit validation and safety boundaries.
description: Create, implement, or review tailwind design system work with format, accessibility, performance, and visual-verification controls. Use when the requested deliverable depends on tailwind design system.

requires: Local tools appropriate to the requested task
An authorized SandBase connection only for optional external capabilities

install.prompt: Use $tailwind-design-system to complete and verify this Tailwind Design System task.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill tailwind-design-system --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill tailwind-design-system --agent codex --global

notes: Optional external calls use dynamic SandBase inspection and paid-call confirmation.

endpoints.summary: Inspect live schemas, limits, and pricing.
Recover recent status and observed cost.
Check balance before an approved batch.
